title: MixDPO: Modeling Preference Strength for Pluralistic Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model preference margins and alignment performance across different annotator education levels (e.g., secondary, vocational, graduate) and employment statuses using the PRISM dataset to show how standard aggregate metrics mask degraded alignment for underrepresented groups.

Calculating and comparing preference margins disaggregated by annotator age groups (e.g., 18-24, 65+ years old) on the PRISM dataset to evaluate how well the model captures age-specific preference differences.
Evaluating the preservation of subgroup-conditioned preferences by comparing preference margins across male and female annotator subgroups in the PRISM dataset.

Assessing cross-cultural and community-specific alignment performance using the Community Alignment dataset, which contains preference judgments spanning multiple cultural contexts and established cultural value dimensions.
